thread:
sophia: FYI — Lumen asking for a POC: 3-node Dedicated pool for ~6 weeks, ~2M tokens/day. They're pushing for 35% off list + $50k POC credit. Wants data residency eu-west. Need deal-desk approval to respond. cc @elaine

matt: Can you share the rough $ numbers? 35% is pretty aggressive without a follow-on commit.

sophia: quick sketch: list price estimate = $0.018/token for this config. Rough monthly spend @2M/day ~= $1.08M. 35% off for POC would be ~ $378k discount pro-rated. They asked for that + $50k credit.
matt: That's large. Recommend we propose: 25% off during POC + $40k credit, contingent on 12m post-POC commit at 15% discount. If they sign 12m, we can escalate.

elaine: From revops perspective: we need an ARR uplift target and a clear renewal trigger. Also need legal input on termination/rollback for Dedicated infra.

sophia: They claim competitor offered 30% + credits. Lumen's procurement is sensitive to bill shock. They said performance/latency is primary.

raj: For Strategic accounts I can approve up to 30% one-off for POCs if there's a signed commitment path. Anything >30% needs CRO (Jaya) signoff.

pricing-bot: Note: discounts >30% require escalation per policy. Include approval_code when submitting.

matt: Also recommend adding a perf-gate: we run a 2-week benchmark window; if latency SLAs not met, customer gets option to pause or reduce nodes. Add rollback clause.

elaine: I'll draft a term sheet and quote with SKU-level lines. Suggest we produce two scenarios in the quote: (A) 30% + $40k credit, 12m follow-on commit at 15%; (B) 25% + $40k credit, 12m at 10% — give commercial flexibility. I'll mark lines requiring CRO approval.

sophia: I'll push back to Lumen and ask if they'd accept scenario A. If they insist on 35%, I'll escalate with support docs (competitive offer screenshot + expected ARR uplift).

matt: One more ask: request access to their benchmark dataset and a 48hr perf window where we can run on Dedicated. That will de-risk the customer and legal.

elaine: Creating quote now: Q-2026-472. Putting tentative 30% lines and noting "pending CRO approval" for >30% buckets. ETA EOD.

sophia: Great — thanks all. I'll update thread after customer call later today :thumbsup:

(ops note) pricing-bot: auto-log created: escalation-required=false (pending CRO if customer pushes >30%).
